notes: Shopify store (rockettstgeorge-live.myshopify.com), direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking. Checked main nav mega-menus (New, SALE, Gifts, Inspiration), collections.json (2 pages, 337 total collections), and site quick-search suggestions (which itself surfaces 'Bestsellers' as a top-level suggestion, confirming it is a real site-defined merchandising concept, not just a filter). Found exactly one Bestsellers listing: /collections/bestsellers. It is a single flat listing with no genuine site-defined sub-categories (no meganav-handle for bestsellers, no children in any menu) -- confirmed by scanning the full rendered nav tree for 'Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Customer Favourites' variants, none found beyond this one collection. Excluded /collections/staff-favourites (20 products) -- this is curated editorial ('staff picks'), not a customer-popularity/bestselling concept, and does not match any target term. QTY: collections.json 'products_count' field is known-inflated on this store per prior Home-Decor pass notes, so ignored it entirely. Instead used exhaustive /collections/bestsellers/products.json?limit=250 (single page returned, 154 unique product IDs, confirming no truncation), cross-checked against the rendered page's own 'X Results' filter-panel text and 'You're viewing 1-39 of 154' header text -- both independently read 154, exact match.
